prompt_head:
You are extracting facts from an Indian listed company's annual report text.
Return ONLY JSON, no commentary, with this exact shape:
{
 "fy": <fiscal year-end calendar year of THIS report, e.g. 2019 for FY2018-19>,
 "unit": "<rupees|lakh|crore|million - the unit the statements are presented in>",
 "signals": [{"type": "<one of auditor_qualified_opinion, auditor_emphasis_of_matter, going_concern_doubt, material_related_party_transactions, auditor_resigned_or_changed, delayed_or_restated_results, loan_or_fund_diversion_alleged, internal_control_weakness>", "present": true/false, "quote": "<VERBATIM text copied from the report that proves it; empty if present is false>"}],
 "current": {"revenue": <number|null>, "cogs": <number|null>, "receivables": <number|null>, "current_assets": <number|null>, "ppe": <number|null>, "total_assets": <number|null>, "depreciation": <number|null>, "sga": <number|null>, "current_liabilities": <number|null>, "long_term_debt": <number|null>, "net_income": <number|null>, "cfo": <number|null>, "retained_earnings": <number|null>, "ebit": <number|null>, "equity": <number|null>, "total_liabilities": <number|null>},
 "prior": {"revenue": <number|null>, "cogs": <number|null>, "receivables": <number|null>, "current_assets": <number|null>, "ppe": <number|null>, "total_assets": <number|null>, "depreciation": <number|null>, "sga": <number|null>, "current_liabilities": <number|null>, "long_term_debt": <number|null>, "net_income": <number|null>, "cfo": <number|nul
